answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution before the ledger credits work. The onyx is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lotus.
